title: Director Solutions (m/f/d)
description:
Director Solutions (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites in Europe and the US · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

A robot deal is won twice: once when the contract is signed, and once when the cell runs the customer’s orders at the throughput we promised. The distance between the two is decided before anyone unpacks a crate: by the site survey, the item spectrum, the cell concept, the integration with the customer’s warehouse systems, and by the number we write into the contract.

We are moving from single stations to fleets, with customers who order dozens of systems at once. The deals are getting larger, the sites more varied, and a concept that does not fit the site is paid for in months of commissioning. We are looking for the technical counterpart to our sales team: a leader who sits next to every account executive from the first conversation and makes deals technically feasible. Someone who has deployed robots personally, knows what a real site does to a design, finds the solution that makes the customer’s use case work, and makes sure what we promise is what we can build.

The Real-World Learning Loop starts with your design

Cortex learns from live deployments. The cell you design is the body the model works in, and a concept that goes live in weeks instead of months is weeks of real-world data no one else has.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every station runs the current policy on the customer’s items. Your surface on it: reach, camera placement and item presentation that let the policy do its job on day one.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: standard cells with a known stack wherever possible, so every pick teaches the same model.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: the item spectrum and the sample tests you run before signature, so curation starts before go-live.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies return to the fleet after validation. Your surface on it: concepts that transfer, so a policy proven on one cell works on the next.

A site designed right goes live faster, teaches Cortex more, and grows.

Responsibilities

  • Be Sales’ technical counterpart on every deal. One solutions lead next to every account executive, from the first customer conversation to signature. Your job is to make the deal technically feasible: understand the customer’s process, find the solution that works for their site and items, and give Sales a technical story the customer’s engineers believe.

  • Own the technical solution for every deal, from the first site visit to the signed scope: site survey, process and material-flow analysis, item spectrum, cell concept and layout, reach and camera study, integration concept for WMS, WCS and conveyors, safety concept. One package per deal, and you are accountable for it.

  • Set the number. Throughput, pick success and intervention rates we commit to per site, derived from the item spectrum and the site and checked against what comparable live sites actually do. No KPI goes into a contract without your sign-off.

  • Standard first. Configure our standard single-arm, dual-arm and mobile products to the site. Every deviation is a documented decision taken with Engineering, not a discovery during installation.

  • Run the gate. No contract is signed without your solution design sign-off and a delivery slot agreed with Operations. You hold the pen on the technical statement of work, the acceptance criteria and the site-readiness list the customer has to meet.

  • Make it feasible, fast. Sample tests, pick studies and scanning or dimensioning checks with our applied AI team, within days, not months. When a requirement does not fit, find the version that does: a different cell or item presentation, a phased scope, a pilot that proves the hard part first. A no is the last answer, not the first.

  • Hand over to Deployment a package that builds: layout, configuration, integration spec, acceptance criteria, risks and dates, so commissioning executes without reopening the concept. You stay accountable until the first live orders prove the design.

  • Own the interfaces to integrators and WMS vendors at the solution level, from AutoStore and goods-to-person systems to conveyor and WMS partners: interface specs, a clear split of responsibilities and readiness tests before we ship.

  • Build the solution library: reference designs per use case (goods-to-person ports, put walls, returns, decanting, store replenishment), throughput models, layout templates and integration patterns, so the tenth deal of a kind takes a day, not a month.

  • Close the loop from the field. What commissioning and live sites learn about a design flows back into the reference concepts and into requirements for Product and Engineering.

  • Lead the big pursuits in person: the technical counterpart to the customer’s engineering and operations teams in fleet deals, tenders and RFPs; demos and reference visits with the customer’s real items.

  • Build and lead the Solutions team in Europe and the US: solutions engineers who have stood at a cell, with the playbooks and tools (CAD, simulation, throughput models) to do this at ten times today’s deal flow.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations and Deployment, Service Accounts, Systems Engineering, Applied AI and Supply Chain. Report to the CEO and be part of the leadership team.

Not in scope, by design

  • Pricing, contract terms and closing stay with Sales. You are their technical counterpart: you own what we promise technically, how we make it work and when it can be delivered.

What makes this role hard

  • Your job is to find the yes we can deliver. Most of the time that means a smarter solution, sometimes a different scope or a later date, and occasionally a no to a deal the company wants. When it is a no, you have to be right about it, with numbers.

  • The product moves fast: what the model could not do in spring it may do in autumn. You commit to today’s capability and plan for tomorrow’s, and you do not confuse the two.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description:
YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

  • CAD conversion as a real pipeline. It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else.

  • Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite. That architecture is what the whole product now sits on.

 

What is coming:

 

  • 3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets

  • Constraint solvers and optimization, and getting an agent to use one sensibly

  • Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object, which is still an open problem

  • Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere

 

We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers.

 

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

 

  • You have shipped production systems across frontend and backend, and can point at them

  • Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack

  • You use AI heavily to go faster, but you built things the hard way first

  • You are fine when the problem is not yet defined

  • You deliver end to end, and you are still there when it needs maintaining

 

Bonus: CAD, computational geometry, constraint solving or optimization, 3D, LLM agents, industrial software. None required.

description:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany/ San Francisco, USA or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.


Why This Role

Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI.

We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics.

What You’ll Work On

  • Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping.

  • Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims.

  • Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required.

  • Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do.

  • International transfers and vendors. Manage EU–US transfer mechanisms (SCCs, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and TIAs), and run privacy diligence on sub-processors and AI tooling.

  • US privacy. Track and implement obligations under US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and peers) and emerging AI-specific state legislation.

  • Regulatory interface. Prepare BFL for engagement with data protection authorities, and handle data subject requests, complaints and incidents, including breach assessment and notification.

  • Policy and documentation. Draft and maintain privacy notices, internal policies, records of processing and the privacy elements of compliance documentation.

  • Scale the function. Build playbooks, templates and training so the rest of BFL can handle routine privacy questions without you.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years’ PQE as a qualified lawyer in an EU/EEA jurisdiction or the UK, with a substantial focus on data protection and product counselling

  • Experience at a technology company, in a top-tier law firm’s privacy or tech practice, or both – ideally including time in-house advising product teams directly

  • Deep, practical command of the GDPR (and the German BDSG), the ePrivacy framework and international transfer rules, plus a working knowledge of how other relevant EU regulations, such as the EU AI Act, interact with them

  • Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes)

  • A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions

  • Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance

  • Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike

  • An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media

  • Direct experience engaging with data protection authorities or the EU AI Office

  • CIPP/E, CIPT or equivalent certification

  • German language skills

  • An interest in adjacent areas such as security and trust & safety


How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg / San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Closing

US $200,000 - $250,000 USD

title: Paid Search Consultant
description:
About Making Science

Making Science is an international digital acceleration company with over 1,200 experts across 15 markets, including Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Colombia, France, Italy, the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Georgia, and the USA. As a proud consulting partner of Local Planet — the world’s premier network of independent media agencies — we deliver a suite of digital, technology, and performance marketing services to a global clientele. Our expertise spans digital marketing and MarTech, software and cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and SaaS, all underscored by a relentless pursuit of innovation.

Making Science was ranked 15th in the FT1000: Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies 2023. Committed to making a positive impact, Making Science actively engages in various ESG initiatives. We’ve joined forces with the Climate Pledge, the United Nations Global Compact, and Pledge1%, dedicating resources and efforts to support non-profit organizations. Through these endeavors, we are committed to driving meaningful change for a brighter, more sustainable future.

As part of its commitment to innovation, Making Science offers its clients end-to-end capabilities required for consulting, development, integration, and maintenance of advanced IT solutions. Our global network of delivery hubs not only fosters job growth but also serves as an incubator for cultivating top-tier tech talent, fueling projects that accelerate transformation and modernisation.

Our team is composed of experienced digital professionals, who have a wide knowledge in the different stages and disciplines of the digital transformation: Digital Strategy, Infrastructures, Software Development, Creativity and UX/UI Design, Digital Marketing, and Big Data.

Making Science is People Centric, and we actively bet on our employees! We believe that they are the key to any successful business, and therefore, our greatest asset. We strive to provide daily learning opportunities for those who work with us and their colleagues. It is also really important that they enjoy what they do, and have positive experiences. We want our employees to feel proud of their accomplishments, and that they belong to a company that is in constant growth, because each person’s contribution is essential to achieve our success.

We believe in the power of diversity and the value of inclusion. At Making Science, our unique experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives are what drive our innovation and success. We are dedicated to providing an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment where all individuals are respected and feel they belong. Join us and bring your whole self to work!

Some details about your department

The Advertising Department guarantees an increase in the volume of our clients' businesses through advertisements on different platforms: search engines, social media, affiliation, media, programmatic, among others (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, Twitter, LinkedIn, Amazon, Microsoft Advertising, Programmatic, Affiliation, Media). We always work in the different phases of our clients' Customer Journeys. Our DNA is to rely on innovation and technology to be efficient with our clients' investments, and to know how to direct messages to potential users at the right place and at the right time. Measurement is key, because it allows us to reach our clients' business data.

In Advertising, we are not about words, we are about results. Since we are a large team, we always work to promote teamwork and learning from each other. We welcome challenges with a smile on our faces, and we believe that our positive energy promotes good results for our clients.We are a winning team, and we have a great time working as a team. We always challenge ourselves, to foster professional and personal growth.

What we’d like you to do

  • Act as a strategic consultant to different national and international large accounts for all their SEM Strategies.

  • Create strategies on the main searchers. Create, manage and track search Ads campaigns on Google Ads, Search Ads 360 and Bing Ads.

  • Design AI testing roadmaps and implement custom automation scripts.

  • Manage Business Manager and other platforms in depth.

  • Work closely with the clients to define objectives and follow-up on agreed roadmaps.

  • Maintain daily communication with the clients to review campaigns, results, and propose innovative strategies. Participate actively in meeting with clients.

  • Responsible for seeking efficiency and resolving it through process improvement and implementation of new technologies or improvement in their use

What we’d like you to bring

  • We are looking for someone who is proactive and eager to learn, with the ability to adapt to new challenges with a positive attitude.

  • At least 4 years of experience performing similar tasks in other marketing agencies or clients, focused on the execution and management of Paid Search campaigns, leveraging Generative AI (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to optimize ad copy and strategy.

  • Strong proficiency in visual Generative AI tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana) to conceptualize and create high-quality creative assets for campaigns.

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple simultaneous requests across projects, using automation workflows (Zapier, Make, N8N) to reduce manual workload.

  • Technical familiarity with AI development environments (Google AI Studio) and RAG tools (NotebookLM) to build custom solutions and manage knowledge bases efficiently.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a strategic mindset and a hands-on approach to tackling challenges utilizing Agent Space and LLMs.

  • Strong analytical skills, with a knack for working with data and generating insights supported by AI models.

  • Excellent communication and client management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both internal teams and clients.

  • Experience in project coordination and management, with a keen eye for detail.

  • You have a C1 level of English, both spoken and written.

  • Fluent in German both spoken and written.

Nice to have / Plus:

  • Strong proficiency in visual Generative AI tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana) to conceptualize and create high-quality creative assets for campaigns.

  • GA4: Basic and Advanced Concepts for Cross-Channel and Business-Level Analysis.

title: Client Sales Director (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Client Sales Director to lead one of our Client Enterprise Sales teams in Germany. You will manage and develop a senior team of Sales Managers, providing coaching and mentorship, shaping deal strategy, supporting high-stakes negotiations, and designing complex commercial initiatives. You'll build strategic partnerships with enterprise prospects, leading consultative sales cycles and crafting solutions tailored to their specific challenges.

Beyond team leadership, you'll act as a cross-functional connector, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure strategic alignment, remove roadblocks, and accelerate outcomes.

This is more than a job. It's a high-impact opportunity for professional and financial growth, with competitive, performance-based compensation. It's ideal for collaborative, entrepreneurial leaders who thrive in dynamic environments and value long-term customer relationships.

 

YOUR IMPACT

  • Enterprise Deal Execution & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS sales cycles, building data-driven ROI business cases, and consistently closing six-figure enterprise contracts.
  • Pipeline Generation & Regional Territory Health: Demonstrates proactive outbound prospecting, tight collaboration with SDR partners, and rigorous pipeline inspection to maintain high forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue growth.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Commands high-level conversations with C-suite and senior HR/Total Rewards leaders, establishing credibility, handling objections effectively, and building lasting strategic partnerships.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Effectively aligns cross-functional internal resources—including onboarding, legal, and product teams—to ensure seamless deal execution and post-sale client success.
  • Product Mastery & Solution-Selling: Articulates Wellhub's market value proposition clearly, translating product capabilities and case studies into bespoke executive solutions tailored to enterprise pain points.
  • Industry Representation & Network Expansion: Actively expands Wellhub's regional footprint and brand authority through targeted networking, industry event engagement, and relationship building within the HR community.
  • Mission Alignment & Culture Contribution: Exemplifies a commitment to workplace wellbeing, modeling sustainable high performance, collaborative empathy, and strong alignment with Wellhub's core mission.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading and coaching senior sales managers and high-performing SaaS teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, operational rigor, and consistent quota achievement.
  • Enterprise Revenue Growth: Track record of driving new business acquisition and closing high-value, complex deals, ideally within SaaS, HR consulting, or corporate benefits environments.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional ability to build trusted relationships with C-level buyers, navigate intricate decision-making units, and align cross-functional partners to drive strategic outcomes.
  • Data-Driven Strategy & Pipeline Execution: Highly analytical approach to sales metrics and forecasting, leveraging CRM insights to optimize team performance, identify growth levers, and maintain predictability.
  • Persuasive Communication & Fluency: Professional business and technical English fluency, with strong acumen in delivering executive-level presentations, financial business cases, and consultative narratives.
  • Sales Tech & Modern Prospecting Acumen: High technical proficiency across modern sales stacks (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SalesLoft) to scale pipeline generation and streamline sales workflows.
  • Growth Mindset, Agility & Client Centricity: Proactive, outcome-oriented approach with a strong commitment to continuous learning, client advocacy, and navigating change in high-growth, fast-paced environments.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading senior sales teams, driving new business growth, and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

description:
About us

ClearBank was built on the belief that banking infrastructure should enable progress, not slow it down. Our clients, from fintechs and digital asset businesses to banks and financial institutions, use our technology and APIs to power innovative banking and payment propositions.

But we wouldn’t be ClearBank without our people. They’re what powers our technology and the reason we love what we do every day. We’re a group of ambitious, curious people who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo. We believe in fairness, autonomy and choice, empowering our people with the tools and opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to the success of ClearBank and our clients.

About you

You’ll be joining the Product team as a Product Manager – Cross-Border Payments & Digital Assets, reporting to the Head of Product, Cross-Border Payments and Foreign Exchange.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape ClearBank’s next generation of international payments and digital asset propositions.

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of cross-border payments, banking infrastructure and digital assets. You’ll help develop propositions that enable our clients to move money internationally through both traditional payment infrastructure and emerging digital asset and stablecoin rails.

You’ll be comfortable taking complex opportunities from discovery through to launch, working across Product, Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk and Commercial teams.

You’ll combine strong customer understanding with commercial and technical thinking, translating market opportunities and complex payment flows into scalable products that solve genuine customer problems.

You will be

As Product Manager, you’ll own key initiatives across cross-border payments and digital assets, helping define the product strategy, roadmap and delivery priorities.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to understand customer problems, define requirements and take new capabilities from discovery and design through delivery, pilot and commercial launch.

Within cross-border payments, this could include capabilities covering international payment corridors, payment providers and networks, multi-currency payment flows, FX-enabled payments and alternative payment rails.

Within Digital Assets, the role will contribute to developing propositions including stablecoin payments, stablecoin minting and redemption, fiat-to-digital-asset connectivity, custody and tokenisation opportunities

A major part of the role will be connecting these two worlds and exploring how emerging digital asset infrastructure can complement traditional correspondent banking and payment networks to deliver faster, more efficient and scalable global payment propositions.

You’ll also work directly with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to validate propositions and ensure they are commercially viable, operationally scalable and aligned with ClearBank’s risk and regulatory requirements.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute product roadmaps in partnership with the Head of Product, translating strategic objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Own product initiatives across the full lifecycle, from customer discovery and business case development through design, delivery, pilot, launch and ongoing optimisation.

  • Develop and enhance ClearBank’s cross-border payment propositions, including international payment corridors, payment providers, payment networks and new payment rails.

  • Help develop ClearBank’s Digital Assets proposition, including stablecoin payments, minting and redemption, fiat/stablecoin interoperability, custody and tokenisation-related opportunities.

  • Evaluate how traditional correspondent banking, payment networks and blockchain-based rails can be used individually or together to improve international payment propositions.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Architecture and Business Analysis teams to translate customer and business problems into clearly defined product and technology requirements.

  • Lead product discovery with existing and prospective clients to understand customer pain points, underlying use cases and future requirements.

  • Evaluate potential banking, payment and digital asset partners, considering product capability, coverage, commercial model, technology integration and customer proposition.

  • Build business cases and support product-level commercial management, including pricing, volumes, costs, revenue opportunities and product economics.

  • Work closely with Treasury, Operations, Financial Crime, Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to ensure new propositions can operate safely and effectively within ClearBank’s risk appetite and regulatory obligations.

  • Develop appropriate operating models and ensure operational processes, controls and customer journeys are ready ahead of product launch.

Core Skills and Experience

  • Strong Product Management experience within payments, banking, fintech or financial infrastructure.

  • Good understanding of cross-border payments, including correspondent banking, international payment flows and the challenges associated with moving money across currencies and jurisdictions.

  • Experience taking complex financial products from discovery through delivery and launch.

  • Demonstrable experience working with Engineering teams in an Agile product environment.

  • Strong customer-discovery skills, with the ability to turn customer problems and use cases into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Strong commercial mindset, with experience considering pricing, costs, volumes, unit economics and business cases when making product decisions.

  • Ability to understand complex end-to-end payment flows and translate them into clear product, technical and operational requirements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and recommend pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across multidisciplinary teams including Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Financial Crime, Treasury, Risk and Commercial functions.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex payment or technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Financial Control, Accountant
description:
About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Lead owns allocated month-end activities within a small, hands-on team, supporting accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, you will complete month-end tasks, investigate balances and variances, and prepare accounting entries and reconciliations to keep the general ledger accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the Financial Control Lead will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Own allocated month-end close activities and ensure they are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements.

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders.

  • Own the monthly capitalisation and amortisation process for intangible assets, ensuring entries are accurate, supported and appropriately controlled.

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately.

  • Prepare, review and approve bank reconciliations as required, ensuring reconciling items are investigated and resolved promptly.

  • Own monthly balance sheet reconciliations for the relevant areas, including preparing and reviewing reconciliations where required, ensuring all balances are fully supported and outstanding issues are appropriately managed.

  • Take ownership of non-automated accounting entries, ensuring they are accurate, appropriately supported, controlled and clearly documented, with clear audit trails maintained.

  • Build and implement scalable, efficient processes while remaining hands-on in day-to-day delivery where needed.

  • Support the preparation of management, regulatory, statutory and tax reporting requirements as required.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial reporting standards and internal control frameworks

Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help drive and implement automation and process improvements across finance processes, controls and reporting activities, helping to reduce manual effort and improve scalability.

  • Lead initiatives to automate the capture and posting of accounting entries from ClearBank’s core banking and operational systems into the general ledger.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and data quality across Financial Control processes.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and technologies to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and enhance team productivity.

  • Ensure process changes are documented appropriately and supported by effective control frameworks.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships across Finance and the wider business to support accurate financial reporting and operational effectiveness.

  • Work collaboratively with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting and external auditors to ensure reporting requirements are met.

  • Support audit activities by coordinating information requests and providing timely, accurate responses.

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring accounting, control or process expertise.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Month-end reporting processes are delivered accurately, on time and in line with agreed timetables.

  • The general ledger remains well-controlled, supported and reconciled, with minimal audit findings or control weaknesses.

  • Complex accounting areas, including share-based payments, are supported with accurate analysis, appropriate documentation and clear escalation where technical judgement is required.

  • Practical capex accounting experience is applied to ensure capitalisation and amortisation are accurate, well-supported and appropriately controlled as part of the wider Financial Control remit.

  • Financial control processes become increasingly automated, scalable and efficient as ClearBank grows.

  • AI-enabled tools are successfully adopted to improve productivity, insight and operational effectiveness.

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and reliable financial information that supports decision-making and reporting obligations.

  • The role works effectively with colleagues across Finance and the wider business to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Financial Control contributes to a strong control environment while continuously improving efficiency and reducing operational risk.

  • The role demonstrates excellence in both what is delivered and how it is delivered through strong collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement and leadership behaviours.

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).

  • Strong financial accounting and financial control experience within a regulated financial services environment.

  • Experience managing month-end close activities, balance sheet reconciliations and general ledger controls.

  • Experience managing the monthly capitalisation and amortisation of intangible assets, including accurate accounting entries, supporting documentation and financial controls.

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including experience interpreting and applying accounting standards.

  • Experience supporting complex accounting areas, including preparing analysis and documentation to support technical accounting judgements.

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, governance and audit requirements.

  • Proven ability to identify, lead and implement process improvement initiatives.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong financial analysis capability.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of a finance function and make a tangible impact on how the rec hub operates.

Lead Product Designer -Platform Experience - UK (Remote)

We’re looking for experienced, customer-centric and data-driven individuals to join our Product team as a Lead Product Designer - Platform Experiences based out of the UK.

You will help shape a connected, intuitive platform that simplifies complex workflows and makes insights more actionable. This is an ideal role for someone who loves information architecture, systems thinking and creating seamless experiences across products.

Beyond the product, you'll help shape how we work as a design team, raising the quality of our thinking, craft and collaboration.

As an advocate for Product Design excellence within Immersive, you will shape the next generation of AI-powered and agentic experiences within our enterprise cybersecurity platform, Immersive One. You'll help design intelligent, trustworthy workflows that bring together human expertise, AI-assisted decision-making, and increasingly autonomous capabilities.


Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you’ll own product problems from early discovery and definition through to validation, detailed design, delivery and iteration. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering, using research, data and strong product judgement to shape experiences that work for customers and the wider platform.


This is a role for someone who thinks beyond individual screens — considering end-to-end journeys, information architecture, workflows, reusable patterns and how decisions scale across a complex B2B product.


You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our products, designing flexible, intelligent frameworks rooted in object-oriented thinking and guided by customer and user feedback and research. Your product output will drive measurable business outcomes that shape the evolution of our design system to define how cyber resilience comes to life across the Immersive One platform.


Our most successful product designers here bring a potent mix of strategic vision, user empathy, and analytical rigor to their work, while constantly expanding their knowledge through cross-team collaboration. You are the sparring partner for the Product Managers and Engineering teams with a close eye for scalability and commerciality - a true consultant who brings both research and evidence to the table and is able to articulate the ‘Why’ to validate design decisions through experimentation, metrics, and real-world usage.

  • Lead the design of thoughtful, high-quality and scalable product experiences, from defining the right approach through prototyping, validation and detailed design execution.

  • Pioneer the integration of intelligent automation and generative AI into user flows to dramatically boost efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making speed.

  • Transform complex, technical cybersecurity data into clear, intuitive user interfaces that facilitate effective investigation, analysis, and response.

  • Partner closely with research teams to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights, grounding all design decisions in solid data.

  • Champion Object-Oriented UX (OOUX) to create reusable components and streamlined workflows aligned with core platform entities.

  • Govern the evolution of our design system to guarantee cross-product consistency, accessibility, and intelligent adaptability.

  • Leverage customer insights, behavioural analytics and success metrics to inform product priorities, guide design decisions and measure the real-world impact of our solutions.

  • Collaborate with engineering partners to ensure the thoughtful, consistent, and scalable implementation of all product features.

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:

  • Extensive experience in product or UX design, particularly within complex SaaS enterprise, data-driven, and platform environments. Ideally, you have worked on AI-powered features, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, or AI-native products

  • Demonstrated track record designing for complex enterprise UX – ideally B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms.

  • Experience shaping design direction across complex products, making informed design decisions, bringing others along and remaining hands-on in execution.

  • Exceptional collaboration skills to strategically partner with product, engineering, and research to align design outcomes with core business and user objectives.

  • Expertise in systems thinking, sophisticated interaction design, and establishing robust, data-connected workflows.

  • Comfortable using emerging AI tools and rapidly testing ideas with Product and Engineering.

  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in Object-Oriented UX (OOUX), advanced information architecture, and data modeling principles.

  • Ability to define, track, and analyze success metrics to measure the tangible impact and effectiveness of design solutions.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to influence and align diverse, senior-level stakeholders

    We are looking for our Product Designer to be based in the UK, and we offer both remote and hybrid working options.

Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

  • Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

  • Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

  • Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

  • One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work.

Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

  • Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and birthday day off

  • Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover,

  • Career and learning development through the platform and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund

  • Share in the companies success with share options, sales incentives and Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours

  • Informal or formal flexible working options, e.g. flexible start and finish times, reduced hours, job share, remote working

  • We’re a sociable, tight-knit team with monthly socials, and sports clubs. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to movie nights and escape rooms

  • While this is a remote position, we do all meet in our EMEA HQ on a bi annual basis and regularly in person in region.

description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

FAQs

  • Are there specific fellowship start dates or can I start anytime?

    • We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round.

  • I am 10 years out of law school. Can I still apply for the fellowship?

    • The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. title: Senior Software Engineer - Test Infrastructure
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company.

We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites.

About this role:
As a Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us!
  • Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry!
  • Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant!
    • Key responsibilities include:
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links.
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns.
    • Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone.
    • Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms.
    • Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests.
    • Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration.
      • Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally.

Must Haves:
  • 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP).
  • Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools.
  • Experience containerizing applications with Docker.
  • Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines.

Nice to Haves:
  • Experience designing or automating complex HIL/SIL testbed, signal conditioning, fault injection, or hardware emulation.
  • Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS.
  • Familiarity with networking simulation tools (e.g., network emulators, virtual switches) for testing data flows under realistic mission constraints.
  • Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs).
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

Engineering Manager - BCP Content stream (f/m/d)
Founder Talent Acquisition
description:
Who we are

Hexa is a venture studio. Since 2011, we've built more than 60 companies, including 3 unicorns. Every year, our startup studio, Hexa Start, creates 12 companies from scratch, and our accelerator, Hexa Sprint, funds several dozen more. Each Start company begins with a CEO and a CTO we recruit ourselves: finding them is our core business.

That's where you come in. 👀

The role

Our partners bring the ideas. What turns an idea into a real company is the people who build it, so finding the right founders is Hexa's core business. That's your job: convincing aspiring founders to join us, walking them through a life-changing decision, and putting them in front of the right partner at the right time.

Our marketing team builds and nurtures the reservoir of future founders. You turn it into a pipeline for each open role (say, a CTO for a cybersecurity project with experience in LLM-built attacks), run the search with the partner leading the project, assess, and close. Laure, your peer, does the same for each company's first employees.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll need the business sense to read an idea and know what kind of founder it calls for, and a sharp eye for entrepreneurial profiles: you can tell a true entrepreneur from a strong manager, even when both look great on paper.

What you'll actually do

  • Source, hands-on: inbound comes first, but you roll up your sleeves and reach out to everyone who looks on track to start something, before anyone else does,

  • Build a pipeline for every open founder role within two weeks, from your own sourcing, the marketing reservoir and our scoring agents,

  • Own the founder scorecard with the partners and fine-tune it every quarter against real hiring outcomes,

  • Interview, assess and close demanding, sometimes hesitant candidates, alongside partners and our CTO,

  • Tell marketing and community what each search is missing, down to the event it needs,

  • Act as product owner of our recruiting stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, AI agents), and call in agencies when a search runs short.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 7 years in recruiting or talent acquisition, close to founders: fast-growing startup, VC fund, accelerator, studio, or founder and executive search

  • You know what makes a strong founder, and you have examples rather than generalities

  • A track record of closing senior or founder-level candidates, with numbers to back it

  • You build trust fast, and you can challenge a candidate without putting them off

  • You're as comfortable testing an agent or optimizing a workflow as building a relationship

  • You have the standing to disagree with a partner, and the judgment to know when not to

  • You are fluent in English and French

Our recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner

  • Introduction call with our CEO, to deepdive on the role

  • Case study on a live search: pipeline, gaps and your plan for the next two weeks

  • Interviews with two partners

  • References with hiring managers and candidates you've placed

What's in it for you:

  • Package: €62K to €68K gross/year (base salary of €52K–€57K + 20% annual profit sharing)

  • Opportunity to invest in all Hexa portfolio startups at a (very) preferential rate

  • Swile meal card

description:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.
Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.

Pourquoi ce recrutement ?
Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas.
Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence.

Missions

Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes.

1. Enquêter

  • Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs.

  • Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A .

2. Dévoiler

  • Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an.

  • Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites.

  • Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média.

  • Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain :

  • Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat.

  • Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l'onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes.

3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel

  • Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier.

  • Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne.

  • Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances.

  • Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires, toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes.

  • Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen, Commission européenne, Représentation permanente de la France, Assemblée nationale, Sénat, ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés.

  • Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp.

  • Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG.

  • Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ».

Compétences recherchées

Indispensable

  • Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction.

  • Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer.

  • Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre.

  • Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets.

  • Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll.

  • De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits.

  • Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués…

Un vrai plus

  • Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances.

  • Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles).

  • Une expérience d'animation de coalitions.

Profil recherché

Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine.

  • Tu vas chercher toi-même.
    Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources.

  • Tu arrives avec un dossier.
    Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui.

  • Tu es crédible partout.
    Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram.

  • Tu tiens la distance.
    Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite.

  • Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment).
    Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part.

  • Tu es owner.
    Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou.

  • Tu veux un impact réel.
    Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler.

Le package

Contrat : CDI, statut cadre

Arrivée : ASAP

  • RTTs

title: Senior Scientist — Organoid Model Development
description:
Job description

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them — and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

We are looking for a passionate, hands-on Senior Scientist to expand Orakl's biobank to new indications. Working with significant autonomy and reporting to Gizem Altay, Principal Scientist, you will own the establishment of patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — starting with NSCLC and extending to additional tumour types — from tissue receipt and dissociation through to stable, well-characterised lines ready for downstream applications. You will develop and optimise robust culture protocols, ensure reproducibility across donors, and generate the high-quality biological models that power our AI predictive engine and our partnerships with hospitals and pharma.

Preferred experience

Must have

  • PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, or a related field, as well as 5+ years of hands-on experience, including industry or translational settings.

  • Proven, hands-on experience establishing NSCLC patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — including tissue handling, dissociation, embedding, and long-term expansion.

  • Strong track record in primary tumour culture, including troubleshooting low take-rates, and donor-to-donor variability and other optimization including: media formulation, matrix selection, passaging strategies, cryopreservation etc.

  • Exceptional wet-lab fundamentals: sterile technique, routine culture, assay development, and QC.

  • Prior experience in building scientific direction, ownership of QC/characterisation strategy, and decision-making

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan, prioritise, and execute complex experimental pipelines with high quality and reproducibility.
